per_candidate.id: s2:Fast Searches for Astronomical Transients Based on Focal-Field Feature Matching
s2:Probing the Universe with Fast Radio Bursts

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate how the increased instantaneous field of view provided by the Apertif system at the WSRT influences our conceptual understanding of the universe's structure. They focus on fast radio bursts and related technologies, which are adjacent topics.
